==Usage==
This template can be used to create standardized [[Special:AbuseFilter|AbuseFilter]] warnings. Create a custom warning in the MediaWiki namespace, "MediaWiki:Custom-abusefilter-warning-foobar", then add this template to that page. <code>|file=</code> is optional.

<pre><nowiki>
{{AbuseFilter_warning
|file=
|noheader=
|content=
}}
</nowiki></pre>

This template uses HTML table formatting instead of wikitext table formatting. This is due to a bug where, as of March 2021, the Source Editor does not support wikitext table in AbuseFilter warnings.

[[Category:Administrative templates]]</noinclude>
